verdict.rationale: Stable's own marketing documents package forwarding: it says you can 'forward packages' and 'Ship: Forward anywhere in the world, discounted rates included', and every plan includes ship as a basic mail action. That covers the forwarding part of the story. Nothing in the evidence says the address accepts packages from all major carriers (UPS, FedEx, DHL), and consolidation and hold-for-pickup are never mentioned. Missing for 10: confirmation the address accepts packages from all major carriers, package consolidation, hold-for-pickup option, and independent or hands-on corroboration of package forwarding.
